I loved how Quartermaester’s Game of Thrones map lets you follow characters up to the chapter you’ve read. I wanted to do that for Carl and Donut’s levels, skills, and gear.

Thanks to the editors of the Dungeon Crawler Carl Wiki for helping me cross-check details.

About the Lookbook

I’m Anders Swanson. I built this unofficial companion to Matt Dinniman’s Dungeon Crawler Carl with dbt Charts.

Reading the charts

Each point marks a passage. If a line goes from level 8 to level 12, those are the two readings I found. The character may have leveled up several times in between.

On the stat chart, ● marks an exact reading. ○ means an estimate or a minimum. Base stats exclude gear and temporary bonuses.

The slider hides later chapters. A shared link opens at the sender’s place in the series.
